newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end lower. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end lower. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to make clear shares ended lower not higher).

Delhi shares closed lower on selling by domestic financial institutions and on the expectation that coal prices would rise after the government decided to deregulate prices and distribution, brokers said.
The Delhi Sensitive Index closed 4.71 points lower at 744.45.
Brokers said foreign institutional investors bought shares of multinational companies while domestic financial institutions sold stocks.
"The market has been witnessing speculative activity for the last several sessions and making both ways wild movements," B.K. Nagpal of brokers B.B. Portfolio said.
Nestle India Ltd edged up in narrow trade by one rupee to end at 231.50.
Bajaj Auto gained 21 rupees to end at 938 on buying by Bombay-based traders and mutual funds.
TELCO fell 1.45 rupees to 331.55 on selling by domestic financial institutions.
Reliance Industries dropped 4.95 rupees to close at 272.45.
State Bank of India fell 3.05 rupees to 278.60.
Larsen and Toubro shed 2.10 rupees at 245.40.
